notes:
Crisp looks new. The whole app has been rebuilt on a deeper, calmer dark palette so panels, the preview and the timeline read as separate surfaces instead of one flat grey sheet, with crisper corners and quieter edges. Nothing moved, so everything is where you left it.

Moving your licence between Macs now tells the truth. Deactivate used to report a seat as released when it had never asked, so a seat could look free while it was still held.

A licence saved by an earlier version keeps working on this one.

Trimming is safer: a start or end time that is not a real number is refused up front instead of producing an odd clip.

If a render from a previous session is still running when Crisp starts, it now says so rather than leaving it quietly alive.
